about: local contests of 2022 in North Dakota, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds (D3). Built by pipeline/local_medsl.py from pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py's cache.

medsl.name: MIT Election Data and Science Lab, Precinct-Level Returns 2022 by Individual State, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/UYQIEP, version 5.0
medsl.note: precinct returns compiled by MEDSL from each state's official sources (named per state in its README); added up to the contest by pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py, files 2022-nd-local-precinct-general.csv

model.name: the model's own forecast, method D3-v1.1
model.note: each year forecast from a fit on earlier years only; no polls are used

nara.name: National Archives, Electoral College Results (the sitting president's party)
nara.licence: US federal public record; no licence printed

klarner.name: Carl Klarner, State Legislative Election Returns, 1967-2022, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/FJOGJB, v1.0, released 2024-06-12T21:56:14Z (the races route (a) is fitted on)

nd_sos.name: North Dakota Secretary of State, Official 2022 General Election Results: judicial contests
nd_sos.licence: no licence printed; the North Dakota Secretary of State's official election returns, public records
nd_sos.via: pipeline/intake/nd_sos.py; front page https://results.sos.nd.gov/Default.aspx?map=Cty&eid=vxUYQ0lrpP4., linked from https://www.sos.nd.gov/elections/election-results as 'General Election - November 8, 2022'
nd_sos.note:
the votes of each contest whose result.votes_source is 'nd_sos' (MEDSL's in result.medsl_votes), and North Dakota's 2022 district court judgeships, each as the state lists it (result.office_as_listed); the front page heads them '
